segments.sn22.88:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn22.88:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā assaji kassapakārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
segments.sn22.88:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā assaji upaṭṭhāke āmantesi –
segments.sn22.88:1.4: “etha tumhe, āvuso, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamatha; upasaṅkamitvā mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandatha –
segments.sn22.88:1.8: ‘sādhu kira, bhante, bhagavā yena assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā’”ti.
segments.sn22.88:1.9: “Evamāvuso”ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato assajissa paṭissutvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ –
segments.sn22.88:1.10: “assaji, bhante, bhikkhu ābādhiko … pe … sādhu kira, bhante, bhagavā yena assaji bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā”ti.
segments.sn22.88:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā assaji tenupasaṅkami.
segments.sn22.88:2.2: Addasā kho āyasmā assaji bhagavantaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.sn22.88:2.4: Atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ [āyasmato assajissa (pī. ka.)] etadavoca –
segments.sn22.88:2.7: Nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. Nisajja kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ assajiṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.88:2.8: “kacci te, assaji, khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ … pe … paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo”ti?
segments.sn22.88:3.1: “Na me, bhante, khamanīyaṃ … pe … abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo”ti.
segments.sn22.88:3.2: “Kacci te, assaji, na kiñci kukkuccaṃ na koci vippaṭisāro”ti?
segments.sn22.88:3.3: “Taggha me, bhante, anappakaṃ kukkuccaṃ anappako vippaṭisāro”ti.
segments.sn22.88:3.4: “Kacci pana taṃ, assaji, attā sīlato na upavadatī”ti?
segments.sn22.88:3.5: “Na kho maṃ, bhante, attā sīlato upavadatī”ti.
segments.sn22.88:3.6: “No ce kira taṃ, assaji, attā sīlato upavadati, atha kiñca te kukkuccaṃ ko ca vippaṭisāro”ti?
segments.sn22.88:3.7: “Pubbe khvāhaṃ, bhante, gelaññe passambhetvā passambhetvā kāyasaṅkhāre viharāmi, sohaṃ samādhiṃ nappaṭilabhāmi.
segments.sn22.88:3.8: Tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhato evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn22.88:3.10: “Ye te, assaji, samaṇabrāhmaṇā samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññā tesaṃ taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhataṃ evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn22.88:4.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assaji, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.88:4.3: “Aniccaṃ, bhante”… pe … viññāṇaṃ … pe … tasmātiha … pe … evaṃ passaṃ … pe … nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
segments.sn22.88:4.8: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati [vediyati (sī. pī.)], sā ‘aniccā’ti pajānāti. ‘Anajjhositā’ti pajānāti. ‘Anabhinanditā’ti pajānāti.
segments.sn22.88:4.9: Dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati, sā ‘aniccā’ti pajānāti. ‘Anajjhositā’ti pajānāti. ‘Anabhinanditā’ti pajānāti.
segments.sn22.88:4.10: Adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati, sā ‘aniccā’ti pajānāti … pe …‘anabhinanditā’ti pajānāti.
segments.sn22.88:4.11: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati, visaṃyutto naṃ vedayati;
segments.sn22.88:4.12: dukkhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati, visaṃyutto naṃ vedayati;
segments.sn22.88:4.13: adukkhamasukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayati, visaṃyutto naṃ vedayati.
segments.sn22.88:4.14: So kāyapariyantikaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. Jīvitapariyantikaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayamānāe ‘jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. ‘Kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī’ti pajānāti. “Seyyathāpi, assaji, telañca paṭicca, vaṭṭiñca paṭicca, telappadīpo jhāyeyya; tasseva telassa ca vaṭṭiyā ca pariyādānā anāhāro nibbāyeyya. Evameva kho, assaji, bhikkhu kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘kāyapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti. Jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayamāno ‘jīvitapariyantikaṃ vedanaṃ vedayāmī’ti pajānāti.
segments.sn22.88:4.15: ‘Kāyassa bhedā uddhaṃ jīvitapariyādānā idheva sabbavedayitāni anabhinanditāni sītībhavissantī’ti pajānātī”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe kassapakārāmeti kassapaseṭṭhinā kārite ārāme.
Kāyasaṅkhāreti assāsapassāse.
So hi te catutthajjhānena passambhitvā passambhitvā vihāsi.
Evaṃ hotīti idāni taṃ samādhiṃ appaṭilabhantassa evaṃ hoti.
No cassāhaṃ parihāyāmīti kacci nu kho ahaṃ sāsanato na parihāyāmi?
Tassa kira ābādhadosena appitappitā samāpatti parihāyi, tasmā evaṃ cintesi.
Samādhisārakā samādhisāmaññāti samādhiṃyeva sārañca sāmaññañca maññanti.
Mayhaṃ pana sāsane na etaṃ sāraṃ, vipassanāmaggaphalāni sāraṃ.
So tvaṃ samādhito parihāyanto kasmā cintesi “sāsanato parihāyāmī”ti.
Evaṃ theraṃ assāsetvā idānissa tiparivaṭṭaṃ dhammadesanaṃ ārabhanto taṃ kiṃ maññasītiādimāha.
Athassa tiparivaṭṭadesanāvasāne arahattaṃ pattassa satatavihāraṃ dassento so sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vedayatītiādimāha.
Tattha anabhinanditāti pajānātīti sukhavedanāya tāva abhinandanā hotu, dukkhavedanāya kathaṃ hotīti?
Dukkhaṃ patvā sukhaṃ pattheti, yadaggena sukhaṃ pattheti, tadaggena dukkhaṃ patthetiyeva.
Sukhavipariṇāmena hi dukkhaṃ āgatameva hotīti evaṃ dukkhe abhinandanā veditabbā.
Sesaṃ pubbe vuttanayamevāti.
Chaṭṭhaṃ.
Passambhitvāti nirodhetvā.
No ca svāhanti no ca su ahaṃ.
Parihāyi kuppadhammattā.
Etanti samādhimattasāraṃ, sīlamatte pana vattabbameva natthi.
Kathaṃ hotīti kathaṃ abhinandanā hoti.
Dukkhaṃ patvāti dukkhuppattihetu sukhaṃ pattheti “evaṃ me dukkhapariḷāho na bhavissatī”ti.
Yadaggenāti yena bhāgena.
“Dukkhaṃ patthetiyevā”ti vatvā tattha kāraṇamāha “sukhavipariṇāmena hī”tiādi.
Sukhaviparivatte sukhavipariṇāmadukkhaṃ, tasmā sukhaṃ abhinandanto atthato dukkhaṃ abhinandati nāma.
